images.title: My looks
images.description: Keep complete looks in one in-game gallery and switch between them with one click
images.alt: The My looks gallery in NCL Skins with saved player looks

images.title: Edit and preview your complete look
images.description: Customize the skin, Classic or Slim model, Cape or Elytra, and individual Second layer parts before saving
images.alt: The Edit look screen in NCL Skins with a large player preview and appearance controls

images.title: Browse skin collections
images.description: Find standard Minecraft characters, Mojang event skins, and collections from active resourcepacks
images.alt: The NCL Skins Catalog with Search, a model filter, and skin cards from the Standard collection

images.title: Import a skin from your preferred source
images.description: Choose a file, find a player skin by name or UUID, add a direct link, or import from other apps
images.alt: The NCL Skins Import screen with options for a file, player name or UUID, direct link, and other apps

images.title: Review looks before importing
images.description: Separate new looks from ones you already have and select only the ones you want to add
images.alt: The NCL Skins import review screen with new and duplicate looks and selected cards

images.title: Built into Minecraft
images.description: Open My looks by clicking your player on the Main Menu or Game Menu
images.alt: The Minecraft Main Menu with the integrated current-player preview from NCL Skins
